Mantech Intl (MANT) Shareholder Rk Capital Management Has Lifted Its Stake; As Travelers Companies (TRV) Stock Declined, Uss Investment Management LTD Has Lifted Its Stake by $2.36 Million
June 15, 2018 - By Ellis Scott
Rk Capital Management Llc increased its stake in Mantech Intl Corp (MANT) by 14.4% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Rk Capital Management Llc bought 31,200 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.34% with the market. The hedge fund held 247,939 shares of the other consumer services company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $13.75 million, up from 216,739 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Rk Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Mantech Intl Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $2.14B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.35% or $0.74 during the last trading session, reaching $54. About 110,378 shares traded. ManTech International Corporation (NASDAQ:MANT) has risen 36.69% since June 15, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 24.12% the S&P500.
